serverInfo.name: aviationstack-mcp
serverInfo.title: Aviationstack MCP
serverInfo.description: MCP server for Aviationstack flight, schedule, and aviation reference data.

aviationstack_api_key.description: Aviationstack API key used to authenticate API requests.

tools.name: get_flight_status
tools.description: Look up one specific flight by its IATA flight number, for the current day or a given date. Returns flight status plus scheduled, estimated and actual times, terminal, gate, baggage belt and delay minutes for both ends, with the operating flight ordered ahead of its codeshares. Use this when the question names a flight number; use flights_with_airline to browse an airline's flights, or historical_flights_by_date for past dates.

flight_date.description: Optional date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to the current day.
flight_date.title: Flight Date

tools.name: flights_with_airline
tools.description: Return live flights for one airline, optionally narrowed to a single flight status. Returns flight number, airline, departure and arrival airports with timezones, scheduled departure time, status, delay, terminal and gate. Use this to survey an airline's current activity; use get_flight_status when you already know the flight number.

airline_name.description: Airline name to filter flights (for example: Delta Air Lines).
airline_name.title: Airline Name

number_of_flights.description: Maximum number of flights to return, from 1 to 100.
number_of_flights.title: Number Of Flights

flight_status.description: Optional flight status filter. One of: scheduled, active, landed, cancelled, incident, diverted.
flight_status.title: Flight Status

tools.name: historical_flights_by_date
tools.description: Return flights that already operated on a past date, with optional airline and route filters. Returns flight date, status, flight number, airline, and both airports with their scheduled times. Requires the Basic plan or higher. Use this for past dates only: use flight_arrival_departure_schedule for today and future_flights_arrival_departure_schedule for later dates.

flight_date.description: Past date to query, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
flight_date.title: Flight Date

number_of_flights.description: Maximum number of flights to return, from 1 to 100.
number_of_flights.title: Number Of Flights

airline_iata.description: Optional airline IATA code filter (for example: DL).
airline_iata.title: Airline Iata

dep_iata.description: Optional departure airport IATA code filter (for example: JFK).
dep_iata.title: Dep Iata

arr_iata.description: Optional arrival airport IATA code filter (for example: LAX).
arr_iata.title: Arr Iata

tools.name: flight_arrival_departure_schedule
tools.description: Return today's arrival or departure board for an airport, optionally filtered by airline name. Returns airline, flight number, scheduled, estimated and actual times, terminals, gates and departure delay per flight. Covers the current day only: for any later date use future_flights_arrival_departure_schedule instead.

schedule_type.description: Whether to return the arrival board or the departure board. One of: arrival, departure.
schedule_type.title: Schedule Type

number_of_flights.description: Maximum number of flights to return, from 1 to 100.
number_of_flights.title: Number Of Flights

tools.name: future_flights_arrival_departure_schedule
tools.description: Return the scheduled arrival or departure board for an airport on a specific future date. Covers any date from tomorrow through about 12 months ahead, including the next 7 days. Returns airline, flight number, scheduled times, arrival airport, terminal, gate and aircraft model. Use flight_arrival_departure_schedule for today's board instead.

schedule_type.description: Whether to return the arrival board or the departure board. One of: arrival, departure.
schedule_type.title: Schedule Type

airline_iata.description: Optional airline IATA code filter (for example: UA).
airline_iata.title: Airline Iata

date.description: Date to query, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Any date from tomorrow through about 12 months ahead, including the next 7 days.
date.title: Date

number_of_flights.description: Maximum number of flights to return, from 1 to 100.
number_of_flights.title: Number Of Flights

tools.name: random_aircraft_type
tools.description: Return a random sample of aircraft types from the Aviationstack reference catalog. Each record has aircraft_name and iata_code. Records are drawn from a random offset, so repeated calls return different rows. This samples the catalog and cannot look up a specific model: there is no search parameter.

number_of_aircraft.description: Number of random aircraft types to sample, from 1 to 100.
number_of_aircraft.title: Number Of Aircraft

tools.name: random_airplanes_detailed_info
tools.description: Return a random sample of individual airplanes from the reference catalog. Each record has model name and code, series, production line, registration number, owner, age, engine type and count, delivery date and first flight date. Records are drawn from a random offset, so repeated calls return different aircraft. Sampling only: there is no lookup by registration.

number_of_airplanes.description: Number of random airplanes to sample, from 1 to 100.
number_of_airplanes.title: Number Of Airplanes

tools.name: random_countries_detailed_info
tools.description: Return a random sample of countries from the reference catalog. Each record has country name, capital, continent, ISO2, ISO3 and numeric ISO codes, FIPS code, currency name and code, phone prefix and population. Records are drawn from a random offset, so repeated calls return different countries. Sampling only: there is no lookup by country name or code.

number_of_countries.description: Number of random countries to sample, from 1 to 100.
number_of_countries.title: Number Of Countries

tools.name: random_cities_detailed_info
tools.description: Return a random sample of cities from the reference catalog. Each record has city name, IATA code, country ISO2, latitude, longitude, timezone, GMT offset and geoname id. Records are drawn from a random offset, so repeated calls return different cities. Sampling only: there is no lookup by city name.

number_of_cities.description: Number of random cities to sample, from 1 to 100.
number_of_cities.title: Number Of Cities

tools.name: list_airports
tools.description: List airports from the reference catalog, one page at a time, with optional text search. Each record has airport name, IATA and ICAO codes, city IATA code, country name and ISO2, timezone and GMT offset, alongside a pagination block carrying limit, offset and total. Use search to resolve an airport name to the IATA code the flight tools expect.

limit.description: Maximum number of airports to return per page, from 1 to 100.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Zero-based offset for pagination. Combine with limit and the total in the response to page through results.
offset.title: Offset

search.description: Optional text matched against airport name and codes. Autocomplete search requires the Basic plan or higher, as does this endpoint.
search.title: Search

tools.name: list_airlines
tools.description: List airlines from the reference catalog, one page at a time, with optional text search. Each record has airline name, IATA and ICAO codes, callsign, operational status, country name and ISO2, alongside a pagination block carrying limit, offset and total. Use search to resolve an airline name to the IATA code the flight tools expect.

limit.description: Maximum number of airlines to return per page, from 1 to 100.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Zero-based offset for pagination. Combine with limit and the total in the response to page through results.
offset.title: Offset

search.description: Optional text matched against airline name and codes. Autocomplete search requires the Basic plan or higher, as does this endpoint.
search.title: Search

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: List scheduled routes, one page at a time, filtered by any combination of airline, departure airport and arrival airport. Each record has airline IATA and ICAO codes, flight number, and departure and arrival airport codes, alongside a pagination block carrying limit, offset and total. This says which routes exist, not whether a flight is operating: use get_flight_status for that. Requires the Basic plan or higher.

limit.description: Maximum number of routes to return per page, from 1 to 100.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Zero-based offset for pagination. Combine with limit and the total in the response to page through results.
offset.title: Offset

dep_iata.description: Optional departure airport IATA code filter.
dep_iata.title: Dep Iata

arr_iata.description: Optional arrival airport IATA code filter.
arr_iata.title: Arr Iata

tools.name: list_taxes
tools.description: List aviation taxes from the reference catalog, one page at a time, with optional text search. Each record has tax id, tax name and the associated IATA code, alongside a pagination block carrying limit, offset and total. This is static reference data, not fares or amounts charged on a booking. Requires a paid plan.

limit.description: Maximum number of tax records to return per page, from 1 to 100.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Zero-based offset for pagination. Combine with limit and the total in the response to page through results.
offset.title: Offset

search.description: Optional text matched against tax name and IATA code.
search.title: Search
